instruction: Candid documentary photograph, low-angle medium full shot. Inside a gym with a treadmill and a chain-link fence in the background, the woman in the gray t-shirt (R2) squats in the center-right, holding heavy black battle ropes with a focused expression. On the far left, the man in the green jacket (R1) leans forward, gesturing with his hand to guide and encourage her workout. Cool overhead fluorescent lighting illuminates the concrete floor and gym equipment, creating a gritty, athletic atmosphere. The floor is dark rubber matting.
